items.item:
10. A05-3, A05-4: Two edges guarded on the same port with the same value into one input are
    refused in phase 6.
    [witness: verification:kernel_a05_same_guard_value_edges_refused]
statements: A05-3: can_both_deliver(e1, e2) <-> NOT (guarded_same_port(e1, e2) AND e1.guard_value != e2.guard_value)
A05-4: for_all port: count(can_both_deliver edges into port) <= 1

verdicts.item:
10. A05-3, A05-4: Two edges guarded on the same port with the same value into one input are
    refused in phase 6.
    [witness: verification:kernel_a05_same_guard_value_edges_refused]
statements: A05-3: can_both_deliver(e1, e2) <-> NOT (guarded_same_port(e1, e2) AND e1.guard_value != e2.guard_value)
A05-4: for_all port: count(can_both_deliver edges into port) <= 1
verdicts.why: The check detects phase-6 fan-in for two same-port, same-value guarded edges and proves the same graph with different guard values, covering A05-4’s violating case and both value branches when guarded_same_port is true. It does not assert A05-3’s full biconditional when guarded_same_port is false, such as different guard ports or source nodes.
